introduction: WOOKTOOL pocket tape measures support promotional, gift, retail and private-label programs that need a compact branded measuring tool. The product direction can be built around logo visibility, shell color, keychain format and packaging presentation.
For a faster review, provide quantity, logo artwork, target market, preferred packaging and any color reference. This helps confirm the suitable model, branding method and quality-control points.

faq.question: Can a pocket tape measure be used for promotional programs?
faq.answer: Yes. Compact tape measures can be considered for branded gifts, retail promotions and private-label tool programs.

faq.question: Can the keychain and shell be customized?
faq.answer: Shell color, logo treatment and accessory direction can be reviewed for the selected model.

faq.question: What packaging can be discussed?
faq.answer: Bulk packs, retail packaging, barcode labels and carton marks can be reviewed around the target sales channel.

faq.question: What is checked before shipment?
faq.answer: Checks can include blade marking, shell and keychain assembly, logo appearance, quantity and finished packaging.
